beat: Paint removal from elbow/side waist; touch mechanics, growing private interest and compliment

lines.original: Dhika: oh this paint is drying in my elbow now and it is kind of etching....
lines.local: Dhika: Oh, elbow par paint sookh raha hai aur ab kuch khujli-si ho rahi hai.

lines.original: Chotu: hehe... you want to clean it now didi?
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe, abhi clean karna hai didi?

lines.original: Dhika: yeahhhhhhhhh.... she shouted and ran to her bedroom.
lines.local: Dhika: Haaaan! Chillaate hue bedroom ki taraf bhaagi.

lines.original: Laughing, Chotu kept everything down and came back to the hall... still shirtless. By the time he reached, Dhika hopped from the bedroom and sat on the sofa.... She dipped the nail polish remover in a small cloth and started rubbing the paint of her elbow..
lines.local: Chotu hanste hue painting ka saamaan neeche rakhkar, shirtless hi hall mein aa gaya. Tab tak Dhika bedroom se nikalkar sofa par baith chuki thi. Chhote kapde par nail-polish remover lagaakar elbow ka paint ragadkar utaarne lagi.

lines.original: Dhika: Ohhk... I can't reach here properly...mfffp
lines.local: Dhika: Okk... yahan theek se reach nahi kar paa rahi... mffp!

lines.original: After elbow...she started reaching her stomach side but it wasn't easy and the field of view was very limited.
lines.local: Elbow ke baad pet ke side tak pahunchne ki koshish ki, par angle aur limited view ki wajah se mushkil ho raha tha.

lines.original: Chotu: hehe....here give it to me didi.....
lines.local: Chotu: Hehe, laaiye didi, mujhe do.

lines.original: He sat on his knees and tried removing but it was being very difficult.
lines.local: Woh ghutnon par baithkar paint hataane laga, lekin use bhi kaafi mushkil ho rahi thi.

lines.original: Chotu put his finger into a little fold in her hips to remove the paint... not being very successfully... very casually, he used his two fingers to open up the little fold to remove the paint.
lines.local: Chotu ne uske hip ki chhoti skin fold ke beech paint nikaalne ko ungli daali. Safalta nahi mili toh casual tareeke se do ungliyon se fold halka kholkar saaf karne laga.

lines.original: Dhika: giggling and a little blushed.... Chotttu, what are you doing ..
lines.local: Dhika halka blush karte aur hanste hue: Chotttuuu, kya kar rahe ho?

lines.original: Chotu: innocently, I can't see the paint Didi... its in between the fold.
lines.local: Chotu seedhepan se: Paint dikh nahi raha didi; fold ke beech mein hai.

lines.original: Dhika saw a little bulge forming in his shorts.... and an unknown excitement was back inside her... giggling... she kept it to herself...
lines.local: Dhika ne uske shorts mein halka bulge banta dekha. Uske andar phir ek anjaani excitement jaagi, magar hansi mein apne tak rakhi.

lines.original: Chotu: didi.... its very dificult like this... can you stand please
lines.local: Chotu: Didi, is tarah bahut mushkil hai. Please khadi ho sakti hain?

lines.original: Dhika: sure dear... saying she stood up near the sofa....
lines.local: Dhika: Zaroor dear. Woh sofa ke paas khadi ho gayi.

lines.original: Chotu stood on his knees and started removing the paint smeared on the side, back of her stomach. He scbangd all of the little drops on the side of her stomach and hips.... Every now and then,... his finders would graze a bit of her skin, feeling its smoothness.....
lines.local: Chotu ghutnon par rehkar uske pet ke side aur peechhe lage paint ko saaf karne laga. Pet aur hips ke side ke chhote drops khurachkar hataaye; beech-beech mein ungli uski skin ko graze karti thi aur use uski smoothness mehsoos hoti thi.

lines.original: Chotu: didi........ he called, feeling a little shy.
lines.local: Chotu thoda sharmaakar: Didi...

lines.original: Dhika: yes sweetie.
lines.local: Dhika: Haan sweetie?

lines.original: Chotu: how nice your skin is..... he shied.
lines.local: Chotu: Aapki skin kitni achhi hai... Woh sharmaaya.

lines.original: Dhika: hehe... is it dear ?
lines.local: Dhika: Hehe, achha, dear?

lines.original: Chotu: excited now,... yes didi.... its looks so milky against the orange paint...hehe
lines.local: Chotu excited: Haan didi! Orange paint ke against kitni milky lag rahi hai, hehe.

lines.original: Dhika blushed at his comment. She always had a milky complexion which John loved about and praised. Hearing it from Chotu, she blushed even more.
lines.local: Dhika us compliment par blush kar gayi. Uska complexion hamesha milky raha tha, jise John bhi pasand karke tareef karta tha; Chotu se sunkar woh aur blush hui.

lines.original: Chotu: feeling little bold, but still innocently,..... gosh, I really want to touch and see how it feels....
lines.local: Chotu thoda bold, magar ab bhi innocent andaaz mein: Gosh... sach mein touch karke dekhna chahta hoon kaisa lagta hai.
